title: Can I DECIMATE Dice Chess?
summary: Dice Chess bullet on a dice-chess site: each turn you roll three dice whose faces are piece types; you make one move per die with that piece type. No check rule - capturing the king wins. Goal: win 10 games; he reaches 10 wins.
rules: Each turn roll 3 dice; each die face is a piece type (pawn, knight, bishop, rook, queen, king).

You make up to 3 moves in your turn, one per die, each with a piece of the rolled type (e.g. 'one queen move, one knight move, one pawn move'). Unusable dice are skipped ('we roll absolutely nothing').
Same piece may move again with another die of its type ('double queen', 'double knight').
No check/checkmate: the king can be left in check; capturing the enemy king wins ('King Captured').
win_condition: Capture the enemy king. Video goal: 10 wins (bullet).

board.theme_notes: brown/tan board on green felt background; 3 red piece-icon dice and a ROLL button beside the board; 'YOU WIN (+0.91)' / 'YOU LOSE (-1.00)' coin-stake popups
